requirements.text: For each combination of playing position and college, how many NBA championships have those players won altogether?
Break the players down by nationality and team, and tell me the total number of MVP awards in each group.
For every nationality-and-team combination, what is the players' combined number of Olympic gold medals?
On each team, what is the largest number of NBA championships won by any one player?
What is the average number of FIBA World Cup titles among players from each college?
What is the average age of Lokomotiv Kuban players who are not Nigerian-American?
Among players whose draft-pick number is below one, what is the fewest Olympic gold medals held by a player on each team?
How many French players are there at each playing position?
How many American players are in the dataset?
For each team, total the Olympic gold medals of players who are either Nigerian-American but not Croatian, or who do not play for Bursaspor Basketbol.
Considering players with matching team and home-city records, how many have a known age for each college?
For each playing position, what is the average championship count of the players' teams, considering teams with a matching home-city record?
For every player nationality, what is the lowest championship count among their teams that have a matching home-city record?
Among players with a matching team record, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by a player at each position?
Group teams by their home location and report the total MVP awards won by their players.
For each team location, what is the fewest Olympic gold medals held by an eligible player when either the home city's GDP is above 100 or the player is American?
What is the average player age for each team when the team is based in Los Angeles or the player has won at least one MVP award?
For each team, how many players either play for a team based in San Antonio or have no Olympic gold medals?
Among players whose teams are based in cities with fewer than two million residents, how many players are there of each nationality?
For teams based in Boston, what is the highest championship count at each team location?
By nationality, total the MVP awards for players who are not on the Milwaukee Bucks, have won more than two NBA championships, or play for a team founded in a year other than 1949.
Among players born on March 23, 1919, what is the highest draft-pick number at each position?
How many players are there at each position whose teams were founded after 1946?
For every team founded in 1946 or earlier, how many players are on that team?
For players on teams founded after 1946, what is the average player age for each nationality?
